definitions: A deep, V-shaped cut in the end of a board or timber, resembling a swallow's tail.
A type of formal coat with a long, divided tail at the back, typically worn by men.
Any of various butterflies of the family Papilionidae, typically large and brightly colored, often with tail-like projections on their hindwings.
examples: The carpenter cut a swallow-tail joint.
He wore a swallow-tail to the ball.
A beautiful swallow-tail landed on the flower.
